Faq.q1: How do you ensure project security and confidentiality?
Faq.a1: We adhere to the stricter security standards including ISO 27001 compliance. All projects are covered by comprehensive NDAs and bank-level data encryption protocols.
Faq.q2: What is your typical project timeline for an enterprise solution?
Faq.a2: Our agile methodology allows us to ship MVPs in as little as 4-6 weeks, while complex enterprise systems are typically delivered within 3-6 months with bi-weekly sprint demos.
Faq.q3: Do you provide post-launch support and maintenance?
Faq.a3: Absolutely. We offer 24/7 global support packages with guaranteed response times (SLA) to ensure your critical infrastructure never experiences downtime.
Faq.q4: What technologies does your team specialize in?
Faq.a4: We are industry leaders in modern stacks including Next.js, React Native, Rust, Go, and Cloud Native architectures (AWS/GCP/Azure). We choose the best tool for the job.
